camera_slots.camera_description: Use the fixed Cam_02 northwest-looking living-room view, 20 mm at 1.55 m. The west TV wall occupies the left, the seating island the middle, and the real terrace glazing, terrace and panorama the right. Only the western long edge of the dining setting enters the lower-right corner; the ML05 fitting may meet the upper frame edge. The television wall is the visual protagonist. Keep the architectural edges, floor–wall junction, terrace paving, railing and planted roof legible at mid-key exposure.

Use fixed Cam_04, looking northeast at the master bedroom from the southwest, 20 mm at 1.50 m. The east headboard and bed provide the central composition, with bedside surfaces readable and the complete north wardrobe wall visibly closing its existing niche. The south wardrobe strip belongs to the room and retains its actual visibility at the edge of the locked frame. Let layered evening light reveal upholstery and front divisions without enlarging the room.

Use Cam_12 v3, the level southeast-looking hero from the northwest corner, 22 mm at 1.60 m with the locked downward shift. The front of the sofa forms a modest foreground, approximately 16–23 percent of the image. Dining and the ML04 pendant lead into the kitchen; W03 and the existing grey 05.3 door sit beyond, W02 is the major designed wall and W07 returns at the right edge. The TV wall and terrace are behind the camera and remain outside this view.

Use fixed Cam_03 K1, level and looking south from the northeast side, 20 mm at 1.50 m with the locked downward shift. The kitchen is the subject: show the two working runs, their front grid, worktops and splashbacks, the D13 refrigerator tower and the southern tall-unit wall. Dining and its ML04 pendant enter the right foreground. The TV wall and terrace remain outside the frame; the composition is an exact galley study rather than a second living-room hero.

Use the separately owner-approved Cam_11c, 20 mm at seated eye height 1.20 m, from the north half of the bed near the headboard looking west and slightly southwest. Keep the approved 16:10 frame with horizon at 50 percent. From left to right: south wardrobe approximately 0–24 percent, white pier 24–32 percent, three glazing fields 32–92 percent, right white pier 92–100 percent. The opening sash occupies approximately 32–44 percent, middle field 44–58 percent and broad fixed field 58–92 percent. The north wardrobe, headboard and room door are outside the frame. The bed foot remains low in the foreground and the balcony is approximately 15 cm lower. Use the approved Blender camera reference, not a renamed professional photograph.

rules.authority: Existing plans/model locks and later owner decisions govern geometry. Exact existing apartment camera image governs image-edit framing. G.Design references govern furniture/material/detail language only. Root screenshots are previews, not new geometry. A rendered concept is not an as-built dimensional certificate.
rules.A811: Preserve Nov19 R7: U1/U2/U3 jointly 350 mm toward media wall, nominal rear storage access 850 mm; N_TV length 2850 mm at approved endpoints. Dining 1600×800 mm, four chairs. Actual U kitchen. Principal ceiling nominal 2.70 m; WC soffit 2.40 m. Merged master 05.2–3 and separate 05.1 bedroom. Dimensions are nominal layout studies, not fabrication approval.
rules.A812: Preserve R7 footprint: asymmetrical sofa 3000 mm width, 350 mm forward, nominal 850 mm access to 3220 mm storage niche; separate N_K cabinet 2850×400 mm. Latest owner correction overrides older renders: main sofa back parallel to TV wall, sitting toward TV, dining-side short part a low chaise. Repeat correctly in living reverse and kitchen views. Dining 1600×800 mm, exactly four chairs, two each long side, none at ends. Keep three bedrooms distinct. Nominal principal ceiling 2.70 m, kitchen corner 2.45 m, entry 2.50 m.
rules.A902: Keep six comparison views Cam_12, Cam_02, Cam_03, Cam_04, Cam_11c, Cam_10 plus Cam_02_DAY lighting variant. Main room nominal 2.90 m, actual lower ceilings unchanged. W01 west TV wall and established seating face each other. S18 mentions 3.00×2.40 m U-layout study, not confirmed product/fit. Never use that study as permission to enlarge room. Actual kitchen runs, dining location, doors/control clearances stay. Cam_12 does not show TV wall; do not move TV onto its artwork wall. Terrace levels, WPC steps, rails and real Budapest panorama unchanged.
rules.bathroom: One-metre fixed clear glass at existing open shower edge, actual entry/footprint preserved. Integrated/undermounted basin, no vessel. Vanity from dry side of glass to adjoining wall where that span exists; practical wall storage on existing dry wall, surface mounted unless recess verified. Keep fixtures/tiles. Shower-only reverse image must not gain a vanity inside shower. Mirror face light + halo and restrained vanity underside lighting; 1–2 style-fitting useful objects.
rules.fully_dressed: All earlier room views, including corridors, entrance, wardrobes, utility, all distinct bedrooms and bathrooms. Full-height cabinetry to actual local ceiling, useful shelves and serviceable joints, curtains plus sheers at real positions, rugs and restrained textiles/accessories. Keep circulation and door openings. Same furniture, grain, art and lighting across views. Hidden objects stay out of frame.
rules.light_luxury: Dimmable Philips Hue-compatible warm white typically 2200–2700 K, 2700 K evening; functional wardrobe interior light may be independent. Concealed continuous aluminium/opal diffused profiles without dots at selected TV/storage edges, headboards, useful shelves, worktops, mirror and vanity. Master approximately 3 m concealed headboard strip plus two Hue Go intent retained. No new ceiling cove, false ceiling, spot/track or invented supply; respect ceiling heating/cooling and actual outlets. All drivers accessible. Electrical/wet-zone and fixture support checks pending. Bright readable neutral material colour, no orange wash.
rules.budget: A811 and A812 each HUF 9M design budget + HUF 1M untouched reserve; A902 HUF 18M + HUF 2M reserve. Full gross apartment cost incl bespoke joinery, lights/drivers/profiles/install, outdoor items, delivery; same object from multiple cameras counted once. Existing budgets are allocation targets, not verified prices. Never silently change material identity/quality or overspend; flag risky alternatives.
rules.reference_assignment: Use archived G.Design original images and source-family maps. Verified original project association and proposed cross-project creative pairing must remain distinct. Standalone bathroom can pair with a chosen living base as a labelled design proposal; do not invent source-project identity.
